questions.question:
A statement is given below followed by two conclusions. Choose the appropriate option and state which of the conclusions follow from the statement.

**Statement:**

It is not appropriate for you to mix your personal life with your professional life.

**Conclusion:**

I. Mixing of professional and personal life can be harmful for a person.

II. It is inappropriate to share confidential business information with friends and family.

options.text: Conclusions I and II both follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
I. Mixing of professional and personal life can be harmful for a person. → Does not follow.

The statement does not mention whether mixing professional and personal is harmful or not.

II. It is inappropriate to share confidential business information with friends and family. → Does not follow.

The statement does not mention anything about confidential business information.

Hence, '**Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bags are rubber.

Some rubber are chairs.

All chairs are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rubber are bags.

II. Some chairs are rubber.

III. Some chairs are tables.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All bags are rubber.

Some rubber are chairs.

All chairs are tables.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6bdd8716a1e31be80b3882e1ff5f0d5171c429d4906e550f04c297cefb24b43.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rubber are bags - True (All bags are rubber also gives some rubber are bags).

II. Some chairs are rubber - True (Some rubber are chairs also gives Some chairs are rubber).

III. Some chairs are tables - True (All chairs are tables also gives some chairs are tables)

So, All conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

Similarly,

A state in which there is abnormal blood pressure is called hypertension.

Hence, “blood pressure” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Ashish cycles 11 km south, then turns west and cycles 8 km, then turns north and cycles 6 km, then turns east and cycles 2 km, then turns to his left and cycles 5 km. Where is he now with reference to his starting position?
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:

i) Ashish cycles 11 km south

ii) then turns west and cycles 8 km

iii) then turns north and cycles 6 km

iv) then turns east and cycles 2 km

v) then turns to his left and cycles 5 km

For this question, the figure is given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c8390580573b9f812b6b126c425ab4e1682928e34529b9c2ab25c07dd956d52.png] 

From the above figure, we can see that the **starting point is 'O'** and **the end point is 'D'.**

The distance between OD = (AB - CE) = 8 - 2 = 6 Km west.

Hence, **Option (4) **is correct.
